annotation.title_clean: Nigeria Deepens Defence Tech Push With AI Surveillance Partnership
annotation.title_en: Nigeria Deepens Defence Tech Push With AI Surveillance Partnership
annotation.summary_en: Voice of Nigeria news report on Defence Minister Christopher Musa's visit to Monaco. During the visit he met MARSS UK and MPS Mikopowers about a Multi-domain Hybrid Intelligence Shield project. The project covers AI threat identification, anti-drone systems and command-and-control centres. The report stresses technology transfer and local defence-industry capacity. It does not discuss any governance safeguards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nigeria's Ministry of Defence is pursuing AI-enabled surveillance, anti-drone and integrated command-and-control systems
A Multi-domain Hybrid Intelligence Shield project is proposed with MARSS UK and MPS Mikopowers
Emphasis on technology transfer, local production and indigenous operational capacity
Proposed national and regional command centres and a Centre of Excellence for simulation, training and doctrine
Rationale: insurgency, cross-border crime, and non-state actors' use of emerging technologies such as drones
